changelog: First setup without typing: on Cucù's own network (hotspot) the Wi-Fi page opens by itself (captive portal), the TV shows 'Colleghiamoci!' with a QR to join it while Cucù has no saved network, and 'Fatto!' with a QR to open the app after connecting. A wrong Wi-Fi password brings the hotspot back. The hotspot password is now random for each Cucù (no more 'cucusetup'): it is on the TV and in Settings > Wi-Fi > Cucù's network, with a QR. The same figurine five times shows 'Eccomi!' on the TV (how to reach Cucù) and, with a PIN, lets you choose a new one while the figurine stays; the app shows a banner too. A figurine left on the reader at power-on no longer starts an episode. The app waits for updates to finish before reloading. Empty thumbnails are regenerated. Thinner progress bar on boot and update screens.
